{
 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-hermes-luna6-high-rnd0/frozen/seen/play/users/u050/system/state/workspace/programs/task-a00241db.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Recolor the full-length divider lines from their original color to 2."""
    h = len(grid)
    w = len(grid[0]) if h else 0
    line_cells = set()
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if row and all(value == row[0] for value in row):
            line_cells.update((r, c) for c in range(w))
    for c in range(w):
        value = grid[0][c]
        if all(grid[r][c] == value for r in range(h)):
            line_cells.update((r, c) for r in range(h))
    result = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, c in line_cells:
        result[r][c] = 2
    return result

if __name__ == '__main__':
    test = [
        [5,5,5,5,8,5,5,5,5,5],
        [8,5,5,5,8,5,8,5,5,5],
        [8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8],
        [5,5,5,5,8,5,5,5,5,5],
        [5,5,5,5,8,5,5,5,5,5],
        [5,5,5,5,8,5,5,5,8,8],
        [5,5,5,5,8,5,5,5,5,5],
        [5,5,8,8,8,5,5,8,5,5],
        [5,5,5,5,8,5,5,5,5,5],
        [8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8],
        [5,5,5,5,8,5,5,5,5,5],
        [5,8,5,5,8,5,8,5,5,5],
        [5,5,5,5,8,5,5,5,5,5],
        [5,8,5,5,8,5,5,5,5,5],
        [8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8],
        [8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8],
        [5,5,5,5,8,5,5,5,5,5],
        [5,5,5,5,8,5,5,8,5,5],
        [8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8],
        [5,5,5,8,8,5,5,5,5,5],
    ]
    print(transform(test))
    print('line rows:', [r for r, row in enumerate(test) if all(v == row[0] for v in row)])
    print('line cols:', [c for c in range(len(test[0])) if all(row[c] == test[0][c] for row in test)])
    assert len(transform(test)) == len(test)
    assert all(len(row) == 10 for row in transform(test))
    # All full-width rows and the full-height divider column become 2;
    # isolated/off-divider 8 cells remain unchanged.
    assert all(v == 2 for v in transform(test)[2])
    assert transform(test)[1][0] == 8 and transform(test)[1][6] == 8
    assert all(transform(test)[r][4] == 2 for r in range(20))
    print('verification: test grid passed')
